{{Current events|year=2019|month=06|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
***[[Saudi Arabia]] announces that Abu Usama al-Muhajir, the leader of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]'s [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Yemen Province|Yemeni branch]], has been captured by special forces. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2019/06/25/world/middleeast/25reuters-yemen-security-isis.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Suspected [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Sinai Province|ISIL]] militants attack checkpoints and an assembly center in the [[Egypt]]ian city of [[Arish]]. Seven police officers are killed, along with a civilian. Four militants also died, including one that blew himself up. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/egypt-7-policemen-killed-sinai-attack-190626094845949.html (''Al Jazeera'')]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] militants open fire on [[Agriculture in Nigeria|farmers]] in [[Borno State]], killing 22. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/27/c_138176314.htm (''Xinhua'')]

;Business and economy
*[[AbbVie]], the Illinois-based pharmaceutical company best known for [[Humira]], announces its plan to purchase [[Allergan]], the maker of [[Botox]], for about $63 billion. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-allergan-m-a-abbvie/abbvie-looks-beyond-humira-with-63-billion-deal-for-botox-maker-allergan-idUSKCN1TQ15X (Reuters)]
*[[Safety of electronic cigarettes]]
**[[San Francisco]] becomes the first U.S. city to ban the sale of [[electronic cigarette]]s (vapes) until the health effects of using them are better understood. [[Juul]], the largest producer of e-cigarettes in the United States, which is based in the city, condemns the ban saying the move will drive people back to [[tobacco smoking]] and will create a [[black market]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-48752929 (BBC)]
*The [[Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe]] announces that, effective immediately, foreign currencies such as the [[United States dollar]] or [[South African rand]] will no longer be legal tender in the country, and that any use of foreign currency within [[Zimbabwe]] will be a punishable offense. [https://www.dw.com/en/zimbabwe-shuts-out-foreign-currency-to-tighten-economy/a-49347739 (Deutsche Welle)]
*The Chamber of Commerce of [[Lima]] warns that just under a million Peruvians are at risk of returning to poverty. [https://larepublica.pe/economia/2019/06/24/ccl-mas-de-957-mil-peruanos-en-riesgo-de-regresar-a-la-pobreza/ (La República)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*One woman dies and 21 people are affected after eating lunch in a Seventh-day Adventist church in the district of [[Sorochuco District|Sorochuco]], department of [[Department of Cajamarca|Cajamarca]], in [[Peru]]. The causes of the poisoning are not yet clear. [https://elcomercio.pe/peru/cajamarca/cajamarca-muerto-intoxicacion-21-afectados-almuerzo-noticia-nndc-649112 (''El Comercio'')]
*A brush fire burns at least 32,000 acres of land in the [[Florida Everglades]] amid near record-breaking temperatures. [https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/big-brush-fire-burning-in-florida-everglades-explodes-overnight-doubles-in-size/70008650 (Accuweather)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]], [[Iran–United Arab Emirates relations]], [[Bahrain–Iran relations]]
**Iran's special advisor to the parliament speaker, Hossein Amir Abdollahian, says [[Saudi Arabia]], the [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] and [[Bahrain]] are "toying with regional security by giving territories to a foreign power". [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20190625-iran-warns-saudi-arabia-uae-bahrain-of-toying-with-regional-security/ (Middle East Monitor)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Cannabis in the United States]]
**[[Illinois]] becomes the 11th [[United States|U.S.]] state to legalize the recreational use of [[cannabis]]. The bill, signed into law by [[Governor of Illinois]] [[J. B. Pritzker]], will also remove criminal records for purchasing or possessing 30 grams or less of cannabis. [https://www.apnews.com/7b793d88f3c84417b83db0f770854960 (AP)]

;Politics and elections
*[[LGBT rights in Japan]]
**[[Ibaraki Prefecture]] says it will start issuing [[Recognition of same-sex unions in Japan|partnership certificates for lesbian, gay and transgender couples]] starting July 1. It would be the first such prefectural policy in the [[history of Japan]]. [https://japantoday.com/category/politics/japan-prefecture-to-recognize-partnerships-for-lgbt-couples-from-july (''Japan Today'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Space Test Program#2019|Space Test Program]], [[2019 in spaceflight]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches and deploys 24 satellites, including [[LightSail 2]], [[Green Propellant Infusion Mission]], and the [[Deep Space Atomic Clock]], into orbit via its [[Falcon Heavy]] rocket. Falcon Heavy's sideboosters both returned safely to their landing pads at [[Cape Canaveral Air Force Station]], while the rocket's center booster failed to land on a droneship in the [[Atlantic Ocean]], exploding in the sea. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/25/science/falcon-heavy-spacex-launch.html (''The New York Times'')]
